from pathlib import Path
from datetime import datetime,timezone,timedelta
from urllib.parse import urlsplit
import requests,json,hashlib
root=Path.cwd();out=root/'reports/research/510300_bankers_loan_demand_source_qualification_v1'
sources=out/'sources';sources.mkdir(exist_ok=True)
url='https://camlmac.pbc.gov.cn/diaochatongjisi/116219/116227/index.html'
now=lambda:datetime.now(timezone(timedelta(hours=8))).isoformat()
r={'role':'catalog_root_first_local_receipt','url':url,'requested_at':now(),'attempts':1,'browser_lookup_reads_separate':1}
try:
 s=requests.Session();s.trust_env=False
 resp=s.get(url,timeout=(10,25),headers={'User-Agent':'Mozilla/5.0'},allow_redirects=True)
 body=resp.content
 r.update(status_code=resp.status_code,final_url=resp.url,content_type=resp.headers.get('Content-Type'),bytes=len(body),sha256=hashlib.sha256(body).hexdigest())
 if resp.status_code==200 and len(body)<20*1024*1024:
  p=sources/'catalog_root.html'
  if p.exists():raise RuntimeError('原件已存在')
  p.write_bytes(body);r['path']=p.relative_to(root).as_posix();r['success']=True
 else:r['success']=False
except Exception as exc:r.update(success=False,error=type(exc).__name__+': '+str(exc))
(out/'目录根页首次本地原件回执.json').write_text(json.dumps(r,ensure_ascii=False,indent=2)+'\n',encoding='utf-8')
print('实际原目录根页首次本地取得',json.dumps(r,ensure_ascii=False))
